name: fake-rich
prompt: Create a 22-second vertical 9:16 comedy video: a broke guy acts luxurious online (fake rich selfie video), then reality exposes him. Expressions are the main source of comedy; include close-up reaction shots.

message.hook: LIVE selfie stream: 'Morning, peasants. Just woke up in my penthouse.'
key_points: The penthouse is a $4.99 poster taped over a moldy wall
His landlady wants three months rent, and the phone is hers too

cast.role: broke guy acting rich (base: overconfident). Streams from a tiny moldy room in front of a sea-view poster.
his judgmental landlady in curlers (base: judgmental). Bursts in at the reality switch.

sets.desc: Custom SVG: tiny dirty room (mouldy olive wall, cracks, bare bulb, laundry line, noodle cups, pizza box, door on the right). A big 'paradise' poster (sky, sea, yacht, palm, sun, $4.99 sticker) taped behind Marco; behind it a FINAL NOTICE eviction letter.
Screen-space phone livestream UI: LIVE pill, viewer count (3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0), @marco.billionaire handle, floating hearts, viewer comments, bank alert banner. Hidden during the REALITY section.

style_brief: Sarcastic Grotesque: face-first reaction-meme comedy. Thick #16110E ink outlines, muted dirty colours for the room, saturated fake-luxury poster. Anton meme subtitles with per-speaker highlight. Contrast: glossy fake-rich livestream UI vs ugly reality. Hard cuts, snap zooms, reaction backdrops (speed, dread, rage, burst), flash cut into REALITY.

storyboard.visual: LIVE UI, hearts; Marco overconfident in front of the paradise poster
storyboard.text: Morning, peasants. Just woke up in my penthouse.

storyboard.visual: Marco smug, finishing the line; comment 'bro is that a poster'
smug hold; poster top-right corner peels down revealing mould
caughtLying + eye pop, speed-lines backdrop, viewers 3->2, comment 'THE WALL IS MOLDY'
slaps poster back; fakeSmile with twitch: 'Ocean view, baby.'
overconfident thumbs up: 'Money is not a problem for me.'; comment '@landlady_bev: MARCO.' (setup for the payoff)
smug hold; bank alert drops in: Balance $0.43, Declined: ROLEX STORE
panic eye pop, dread backdrop, viewers 2->1, comment '$0.43 LMAO'
fakeSmile, trembling, sweating: 'That's... my other account.'
three knocks; the fake smile freezes
flash, UI gone, label REALITY: tiny moldy room, Marco holding phone, Bev bursts through the door
Bev angryMeltdown, rage backdrop: 'Marco! Three months rent!'
the poster falls off the wall, FINAL NOTICE revealed
Marco panic -> terrified -> hystericalCry (rule of three, biggest faces), tear fountains
storyboard.camera: close / ecu / close punches, rage/dread/burst backdrops

storyboard.visual: judgmental pucker, pointing: 'And that's my phone.'
Marco crying; SNAP to a desperate fakeSmile, LIVE UI back with 0 viewers: 'Like and subscribe.'
deadInside eyes, held, meme caption POV: THE PENTHOUSE HAS A LANDLADY
storyboard.text: POV: THE PENTHOUSE HAS A LANDLADY

gags.gag: poster corner peels: setup -> peel -> snap caughtLying -> hold -> slap it back + fake smile
bank alert $0.43 on his own livestream: calm hold -> snap ECU panic -> 'my other account'
knock knock -> flash to REALITY -> landlady, poster falls, triple escalation, 'that's my phone'
punchline face: dead eyes after 'like and subscribe', 0 viewers, meme caption

publish._note: Publishing is intentionally not wired. Human review first.
